title: Gemini 2.0 joins the text API
summary:
Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash Thinking joined the text API, with more community projects to discover and clearer feed examples.

Added `gemini` for Gemini 2.0 Flash and `gemini-thinking` for Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking, with temperature and JSON-mode options passed through to the models. The website and README now cover both additions.

Pollinations.DIY, a browser coding environment using Pollinations services, was added to the website and README. Titan-GPT, a Telegram bot for image and text generation, joined the Social Bots lists.

The API docs gained image and text SSE feed examples, while the website’s image-feed example now logs `imageURL`. An Azure-hosted gpt-4o-mini configuration was also added with unsupported parameters omitted.
